resolved_findings: Expanded island spacing and temporary secondary-toolbar/FAB adaptation preserve a usable60dp real app list at320dp width/font1.3; actual contacts and recents images show no header overlap.

bounded_findings.description: The Hebrew New call caption ellipsizes at font1.3 in the existing emerald/iOS three-column normal grid. Its icon remains fully visible; this was already recorded in beta7.
Intentionally long synthetic contact names ellipsize in bounded caller headers. Numbers and main call controls remain visible.

At font1.3 the native Hebrew speaker-on caption is ellipsized. Speaker icon and action remain visible; caller name and call state are fully legible in the body. This matches the prior bounded finding.

Long contact/favorite labels and secondary recent-call date metadata ellipsize within bounded rows. Primary phone numbers, navigation and call icons remain legible. Floating dial overlaps a low list row in the existing baseline placement; rows are scrollable and this is not a new island overlap.
Narrow widget branding or long quick-contact names ellipsize. All four favorite names in the narrow grid remain readable; quick-contact initials and target remain visible.

Five-icon chooser is scrollable at font1.3: top capture partially hides the fifth row, bottom capture fully exposes it and intentionally clips the first row at the scrolled top. Across both captures every icon and name is readable.
The English caller ellipsizes in the intentionally compact260dp capsule atfont1.3; fullcaller remains readable after expansion and the phase/timer/controls fit.
